## p7c Rebuild Cube Session Table Index — Dry Run + Forced Locking

```bash
p7c --dry-run --force-lock rebuild-session-index
```

### Flag Breakdown

| Flag | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `--dry-run` | Executes the rebuild plan without applying changes to the live database. Useful for verifying the operation will succeed and seeing the estimated impact. |
| `--force-lock` | Overrides the normal lock-timeout behavior, forcing the command to acquire locks even when other sessions are holding them. This will block until locks are obtained or the timeout is exceeded. |
| `rebuild-session-index` | The subcommand that triggers the rebuild of the cube session table index. |

### Notes

- `--dry-run` prevents any actual index rebuild or data mutation. It will still report which sessions would be affected and how long the operation would take.
- `--force-lock` is typically used when you want to ensure the rebuild proceeds even under contention, but it comes with the risk of blocking other sessions. Use with caution in production.
